newsitem.title: USA: H.F. Ahmanson Q3 shr loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: H.F. Ahmanson Q3 shr loss vs profit.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

Note - 1996 Q3 loss includes charge of $8.3 million or $0.07 a share related to acquisition of former First Interstate Bank branches and charge of $144.4 million or $1.34 a share for special assessment to recapitalize the Savings Assoc. Insurance Fund (SAIF). Without the charges, EPS would have been a profit of $73.2 million or $0.56 per fully-diluted share.
Q3 1995 net included an after-tax gain of $252.7 million from the sale of the company's New York branch system.

1995 nine months net included the sale of the New York branches and the adoption of an accounting change that resulted in the write-off of $234.7 million of goodwill related to acquisitions prior to 1982. Results for the third quarter and nine months ended Sept 1996, included tax benefits of $19.0 million. During the third quarter of 1996, the company provided $35.8 million for loan losses, compared to $29.2 million in the third quarter of 1995. During the first nine months of 1996, the company provided $115.6 million for loan losses, compared with $81.2 million in the first nine months of 1995.
Assets - $50.6 billion on Sept 30, 1996 vs $50.6 billion on Sept 30 1995
